records.title: 机器大作战
records.Message:

摆锤：以直线的形式攻击
空投：小心并躲避圆形预警区
追踪激光：会持续追踪玩法
跳跃激光：需要进行跳跃躲避
切割机：小心切割机的路径，不要掉下去
生命球：拾取后生命+1（最高3）

records.title: Forest of Seals
records.Message: This is a 2D vertical shooter game. In the backstory, there are four Imprinters, each with their own unique abilities. Players will enter the world ruled by Egret-Deus, one of the four Imprinters. Egret can turn her defeated foes into objects, making them her eternal slaves. The story begins with an accident, where the player, as a Channeler, falls into a 2D plane…

records.title: Gameplay
records.Message:
Move left and right with the sticks, tap the shoot button to fire bullets, and defeat foes to score points.
Earn bonus points for defeating a foe just as it attacks.
The game ends when your health runs out.
Go all out against endless foes to rack up the highest score you can!

records.title: 玩法说明
records.Message:
发射子弹射击海球球。
不同颜色的海球球分值不同，注意不要射击红色的海球球。
命中神秘游客的话，会有额外的奖励。

records.title: Gameplay
records.Message:
Press the shoot button to prepare for a shot, and release it at the right moment to shoot.
Each spot has 5 balls; Ball 3 is a bonus time ball, and Ball 5 is a triple-score ball.
The game ends when all balls have been thrown or time runs out. After both sides are done, the winner is determined based on the scores.

records.title: 赛季玩法说明
records.Message:
组建队伍挑战副本。
击败敌人会获得ACD积分、心相培养材料和信条。
副本中不能使用道具，角色全部阵亡后中止副本并进行结算。
